p10: 'Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme -Tamil Nadu' has is_women_only=True in the DB despite gender-neutral eligibility text -- likely an LLM-extraction error, possibly confused with the sibling Widow Pension scheme during ingestion -- and is therefore excluded for this Male persona.

p5: 'Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme' exists as 2 duplicate rows in government_schemes with identical column values -- both pass the SQL filter independently and may both surface in schemes_fetched, consuming two of the top_k slots with the same name.

hn4: the same scheme's DB max_age=35 is a flat bound that doesn't encode the eligibility text's stated 45-year age relaxation for special categories (SC/ST/MBC/BC/Minorities/Ex-Servicemen/Differently abled/Transgender) -- same category-exception-not-encoded issue as p3.
